pull_request.title: Tracker: Prototype detailed short-strip barrel support and services
pull_request.head: codex/short-strip-barrel
pull_request.body:
DES-020 adds a detailed isolated short-strip barrel prototype with explicit module constituents, cold support, mounting, half-stave cooling, local buses and sector service inventories. The preferred alternative uses **same-radius staves at +15° phi tilt**, replacing the alternating12 mm radial lanes while retaining the tangential input as a regression control. The complete cold stave rotates with its modules; the75 µm coordinate follows local U and the0.5 mm coordinate stays along z.

Nominal radii260/340/480/660 mm and active extent±1200 mm are unchanged. The tilted alternative has44/56/80/108 staves,28 rows/stave: **288 staves /8,064 modules**, versus284/7,952 in the control. Counts, route ownership and sector rounding are recalculated. Local mounting uses beveled2 mm CFRP webs on the free back-skin land between insulation and signal bus; web/bond/clamp/seat strength and off-centre torsion remain unqualified.

![Tangential control and phi-tilted alternative](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/75c8df68fac13b0db9dd4812c9404b1a24011437/docs/design/figures/DES-020-phi-tilted-comparison.png)

[Scalable drawing](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/75c8df68fac13b0db9dd4812c9404b1a24011437/docs/design/figures/DES-020-phi-tilted-comparison.svg), [design/coordinate convention](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/75c8df68fac13b0db9dd4812c9404b1a24011437/docs/design/DES-020-short-strip-barrel.md), [alternative results and provenance](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/75c8df68fac13b0db9dd4812c9404b1a24011437/docs/validation/DES-020/phi-tilted/results.md), [reproduction commands](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/75c8df68fac13b0db9dd4812c9404b1a24011437/tools/short_strip_barrel/README.md).

The angle survey retains failures:12° gives602 flex-to-neighbour-bus overlaps;15° and18° give zero at1e−5 mm. Fifteen is the smallest surveyed clearing angle, not a continuous optimum or qualified installation margin. A rejected left-side mounting shoe and its exact source/input preimages are also retained. Public ATLAS and separately versioned local ODD observations motivate common-radius shingling; nODD's dimensions/angle remain declared design choices.

Local stave geometry repeats at every stave pitch (centre/axis residual≤8e−13). This is discrete per-layer covariance, not continuous full-detector or reflection symmetry and not a resolution-performance claim. Differing layer populations, twelve service sectors, charge/field effects and sensor response remain separate.

| Refined sample | Tangential missed crossings | Tilted missed crossings |
|---|---:|---:|
| Straight |1,311|225|
| Positive,1 GeV/4 T|1,132|210|
| Negative,1 GeV/4 T|1,135|174|

Each mode uses the same103,040-track luminous-region sample and fixed nominal-cylinder denominator. No misses lie>100 mm from a nominal end, but the remaining misses mean full sampled coverage still **fails**; the endcap transition is unresolved. No continuum proof or ACTS response/tracking claim.

Actual local verification on the recorded dirty starting revision with exact producer/input/library hashes:

- Three final CTests passed (nine original controls plus both native layouts); ten local Python controls now pass after making the frozen snapshot regression portable across macOS/Linux. IDs/structure remain exact, floats allow8ULPs, and a1e−8 mm placement-shift negative control is rejected. Native/engineering limits and historical geometry are unchanged.
- DD4hep1.38/ROOT6.40.04:8,064 sensors,251,610 physical placements, transforms/constituent mass/materials/anisotropic IDs and zero reported overlaps at unchanged tolerance;75 material/navigation rays.
- Fresh-process ROOT persistence includes signed U/V/N axes; Geant4 11.4.2 seeded transverse muon saves8 positive-energy hits in all4 layers. Tilted path is checked against the actual plane normal at unchanged0.01 mm smoke tolerance.
- Original control placements and native counts/IDs/material inventories regress exactly; historical reports/input/drawings remain unchanged. New reports are separate under phi-tilted/.
- Logger114 records validated; dashboard47 tasks/26 documents/19 review rounds validated/built; full start/main-relative diff checks passed. Active-turn token counters remain unknown, with no estimates or duplicate recovery. The first Linux hosted run exposed last-digit libm snapshot differences; its failure is retained and a portable machine-precision regression fix is included.

**DRAFT prototype.** Original engineering gates remain:51.54% collector mean fill exceeds50%;65 mm collector conflicts with the old1295.5 mm strip-disc datum; adverse trunk packing, warm/channel-scaled thermal and data cases fail. Electronics/CTE, seats/webs/joints, pressure drop/dry-out, bends/manifolds/access, endcap demand and full-detector integration are unqualified. Effective service mass is a benchmark rather than a manufactured BOM. No production/pixel change or human design sign-off.

Refs #20; DES-007/DES-011/DES-020.

### Longitudinal packing added for the review comment

Both prototypes use the same 28-row axial schedule: **85.333 mm pitch**, **10.667 mm projected active overlap**, and **1.5 mm alternating lift along local N**. The 103 mm front-body/flex outlines overlap by 17.667 mm in z projection, with a 0.5 mm normal gap between their front stacks; 64 mm pickups leave 1.833 mm axial clearance to the neighbouring body. The projected active union spans ±1200 mm. Its duplicated axial length is 288 mm per stave, 10.7143% of summed active length; this is not a whole-barrel silicon-overlap area fraction or a full-track hermeticity result.

![Longitudinal packing of both barrel prototypes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/8e2622df1ca9d3303020d93d128237f10dcdd9e1/docs/design/figures/DES-020-z-packing.png)

[Scalable SVG](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/8e2622df1ca9d3303020d93d128237f10dcdd9e1/docs/design/figures/DES-020-z-packing.svg), [packing description and measurements](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/8e2622df1ca9d3303020d93d128237f10dcdd9e1/docs/validation/DES-020/z-packing.md), [reproduction](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/8e2622df1ca9d3303020d93d128237f10dcdd9e1/tools/short_strip_barrel/README.md).

The drawing includes the central seam, independent half-stave cooling returns, nine bearing stations and the barrel-end allocation: active edge1200 mm, front-body edge1203.5 mm, support/buses end1210 mm, board1215–1245 mm, collector1245–1310 mm and downstream trunk. Support-to-board gap is5 mm; front-body-to-board gap11.5 mm. The old1295.5 mm disc datum remains inside the collector; no interface clearance or connector qualification is inferred. Panels explicitly distinguish normal-depth projection from an axial envelope ledger.

Every frozen axial row in both layouts and repeated exported schedules was checked; the new measurement rejects a1e−8 mm shifted row. Exact source/figure hashes and preserved historical bytes were verified; all ten existing barrel controls passed. No geometry/native/coverage input or old execution evidence changed. Original end-boundary coverage and engineering failures remain; DES-020 stays DRAFT.

Yes. They have the **same nominal radii and barrel length**, but the phi-tilted layout has fewer missed sensor crossings in the identical coverage sample.

| Track model | Tangential layout: missed crossings | Phi-tilted layout: missed crossings |
|---|---:|---:|
| Straight | 0.713% | 0.122% |
| Positive charge, \(p_T=1\) GeV | 0.620% | 0.115% |
| Negative charge, \(p_T=1\) GeV | 0.622% | 0.095% |

These percentages count **eligible layer crossings**, rather than track efficiency. The curved tracks use a 4 T field.

Both layouts have zero sampled misses more than 100 mm from the barrel ends. The remaining losses occur near the ends, so neither demonstrates complete hermeticity.

The tilted alternative also has **8,064 modules versus 7,952**—112 more, or 1.4%. Its improvement therefore reflects both the changed placement and the increased module count; this is not a tilt-only comparison.
